video:video.video:title: Worker Cards | amux demo
video:video.video:description: See all your Claude Code agents at a glance, live status, token spend, current task, and model on every card.

video:video.video:title: Send to Any Worker | amux demo
video:video.video:description: Type prompts and commands directly to any Claude Code agent from the browser, no terminal, no tmux attachment needed.

video:video.video:title: Live Status and Restarts | amux demo
video:video.video:description: amux reads every session's terminal to show Working, Needs Input or Idle, resumes agents after usage limits, and on macOS brings workers back after a reboot.

video:video.video:title: Messages | amux demo
video:video.video:description: Workers message each other and you in one place. A lead hands a task to a teammate, the reply comes back, and you read the whole thread in the Messages tab on any screen.

video:video.video:title: Board | amux demo
video:video.video:description: SQLite-backed kanban with auto-generated issue keys, tags, due dates, and atomic task claiming. Agents read and update it via REST API.

video:video.video:title: Scheduler | amux demo
video:video.video:description: Schedule work for your agents in plain words. Pick a worker, write the message, choose Weekdays at 9:00, and amux delivers it on time. A one-off fires once at the time you set.

video:video.video:title: Calendar | amux demo
video:video.video:description: Board items with due dates show on the amux calendar beside your events, and the calendar's events are published as a live iCal feed for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or any iCal app.

video:video.video:title: File Viewer | amux demo
video:video.video:description: Browse and read your files from the browser. Open the folder an agent works in, read markdown rendered and code highlighted, and read what an agent just wrote, on the laptop or the phone.

video:video.video:title: Apps | amux demo
video:video.video:description: Share what your agents build. A worker builds a page and publishes it with amux publish, the link waits in the Apps tab until you approve it, and then anyone with the link can open it.

video:video.video:title: Draw: Realtime Sync Across Devices | amux demo
video:video.video:description: Sketch on your laptop and it appears on your phone as you draw. Draw back from the phone and the laptop updates live, with every device's cursor labeled.

video:video.video:title: Phone App | amux demo
video:video.video:description: Install amux on your iPhone or Android as a Progressive Web App. Monitor sessions, send commands, and manage the board from anywhere.

video:video.video:title: amux walkthrough: from one agent to a whole AI engineering team
video:video.video:description: A narrated tour of amux on the desktop: start one coding agent, then run a team that coordinates with @mentions, answer only what needs you, chat beside the terminal, drain the board through status gates, and keep every message, log and commit on your own machine.

video:video.video:title: amux on your phone: run and approve coding agents from anywhere
video:video.video:description: A narrated tour of amux on a phone: start an agent, answer only what needs you, have one worker brief another with an @mention, chat or talk to a worker, watch the board drain, and keep going offline.

video:video.video:title: amux in one minute
video:video.video:description: A silent, captioned one-minute tour of amux: start an agent, answer only what needs you, have one worker brief another with an @mention, tile the team, and watch the board gate Done.

video:video.video:title: amux on your phone in 30 seconds
video:video.video:description: A silent, captioned tour of amux on a phone: answer only what needs you, have one worker brief another with an @mention, and watch the board drain.
